_comment: Tracked placeholder art (Ojon 2026-11-23, issue #28 Chapter 2). Every stand-in in the game is listed here: it reuses existing art, recoloured by tools/make_placeholders.py, at the exact path and id the final art will use, so the swap is dropping the new file in (no code or data change) and deleting its entry here. tests/test_placeholders.gd prints this list on every test run and checks each entry; the release check (tools/release_check.sh, issue #118) fails while any entry remains. The GitHub issues #205 (Chapter 2 art swap) and #237 (Chapter 3 art swap, Ojon 2026-11-24, issue #29) and #255 (Chapter 4 art swap, Ojon 2026-11-25, issue #30) track the same list. Fields: id (<kind>:<name>, the name is the art id), kind (sprite, portrait, prop, tiles, icon, music, cg), path (repo path the final art goes to; a folder for sprite sets and ground sets), from (the existing art it is recoloured from; empty for cg: the scene plays without one), recolor (steps, see tools/make_placeholders.py), variants (props: how many _v<n> variants to copy too), for (where the game uses it), final (the brief for the paid art batch; style rules in docs/ART_STYLE.md, sizes match the stand-in unless it says otherwise).

placeholders.for: Eraser Reader, Chapter 2 enemy (data/enemies.json reader)
placeholders.final: Verity's follower: a former Concord archivist in a long whitewashed coat, ledger strapped to the chest, a short burning taper as a blade. 44px canvas, same anims as the sellsword (rot, idle, walk, attack 6, hurt). Attack: a lunge with the taper. Plus 'read' (4-frame loop: ledger held up, reading aloud; scripts/reader.gd plays it while it reads a name, falls back to attack frame 0).

Plus 'paint' (6 frames: dips the brush in the bucket and slaps a stripe across the ground; scripts/whitewasher.gd plays it over the wind-up, falls back to the first half of attack).

placeholders.for: Low Water, Chapter 4 boss (scripts/lowwater.gd)
